---
title: "package-workflows"
subtitle: "Reusable GitHub Actions workflows for R packages"
---

This repository holds **reusable workflows** (`on: workflow_call`) for R
package repositories: checks, releases, and bot suggestions for
documentation, tests and contributor credits. Each package repository only
needs thin *caller* files that point here, so CI logic is written once
instead of being copied into every repository.

A caller is a normal workflow file in your repository whose job `uses:` a
workflow from here:

```yaml
jobs:
  check:
    uses: FlorianSchw/package-workflows/.github/workflows/R-CMD-Check.yml@main
```

::: {.callout-note}
## Work in progress
These workflows are referenced at `@main` and still evolving. Versioned
releases will follow once the inputs have settled — feedback on what you
need is very welcome, see [Roadmap and open questions](roadmap.qmd).
:::

## Workflows

| Group | Workflow | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| Pull request checks | [R CMD check](r-cmd-check.qmd) | `R CMD check` on an OS × R version matrix, optional Codecov upload |
| | [Commitlint](commitlint.qmd) | Checks that commit messages follow Conventional Commits |
| | [Require head branch](require-head-branch.qmd) | Only lets PRs into a branch (e.g. `main`) come from one branch (e.g. `dev`) |
| Release | [Release chain](release.qmd) | How the release workflows below fit together |
| | [Package release](package-release.qmd) | Versions, tags and drafts a GitHub release with semantic-release |
| | [Merge pull request](merge-pull-request.qmd) | Merges a PR from a workflow |
| | [Create issue](create-issue.qmd) | Opens an issue when a check fails |
| | [Trigger release publish](trigger-release-publish.qmd) | Starts the release as a separate run |
| Bot suggestions | [How suggestions work](suggestions.qmd) | Shared mechanics: suggestion PRs, sweeps, cleanup |
| | [DESCRIPTION authors](check-description-authors.qmd) | Suggests adding new contributors to `DESCRIPTION` |
| | [Roxygen suggestions](roxygen-suggest.qmd) | Claude reviews and rewrites roxygen2 documentation |
| | [Test coverage suggestions](test-coverage-suggest.qmd) | Claude writes testthat tests; only passing ones are proposed |
| | [Claude setup](claude-setup.qmd) | Keyless Claude API access for the two workflows above |
| | [Cleanup suggestion branch](cleanup-suggestion-branch.qmd) | Deletes bot branches once their PR is closed |
| Maintenance | [Workflow keepalive](workflow-keepalive.qmd) | Keeps scheduled workflows from being disabled after 60 days of inactivity |

## Where to start

1. [Getting started](getting-started.qmd) — branch model, secrets and the
   GitHub App most workflows rely on.
2. [How it fits together](overview.qmd) — diagrams of what runs when.
3. Copy the example caller of each workflow you want into
   `.github/workflows/` of your repository.
